# LearnMLAcademy

> Free, production-grade Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Agentic AI educational platform with step-by-step mathematical reasoning, original visual diagrams, and reproducible Python code.

LearnMLAcademy provides open-access tutorials, reproducible project handbooks, interactive knowledge checks, and interview preparation guides. All lessons are written for beginners through practitioners, peer-grounded in industry practices, and free of hype.

- Website: https://www.learnmlacademy.com
- Curriculum: https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum
- Hands-On Projects: https://www.learnmlacademy.com/projects
- Technical Blog: https://www.learnmlacademy.com/blog
- Author: Prateek Sharan (https://www.learnmlacademy.com/about)

## Curriculum Modules (17)

- [1. Foundations](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): Mathematical prerequisites, linear algebra, calculus, probability, NumPy, Pandas, and exploratory data analysis.
- [2. Python & ML Libraries](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): Essential Python for ML, vectorized NumPy operations, Pandas DataFrames, data visualization, and scikit-learn.
- [3. Data Preprocessing & Feature Engineering](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): Encoding strategies, standard scaling, feature selection, missing data imputation, and leakage-free pipeline design.
- [4. Supervised Learning](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): Linear regression, logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, SVMs, Naive Bayes, and gradient boosting algorithms.
- [5. Ensemble Learning](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): Bagging, boosting, AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, stacking, and voting classifiers.
- [6. Unsupervised Learning](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): K-Means, hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, PCA dimensionality reduction, t-SNE, and anomaly detection.
- [7. Model Evaluation & Optimization](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): Cross-validation, ROC-AUC, PR curves, bias-variance tradeoff, leakage prevention, and model calibration.
- [8. Time Series & Forecasting](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): Time-series decomposition, ARIMA, SARIMA, Prophet, chronological validation, and lag feature engineering.
- [9. Advanced Learning Paradigms](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): Semi-supervised learning, self-supervised representation, active learning, transfer learning, and few-shot learning.
- [10. Deep Learning](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): Perceptrons, multilayer neural networks, backpropagation, CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, Transformers, and PyTorch implementations.
- [11. Advanced Deep Learning Topics](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): State-Space Models (SSMs/Mamba), Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), Physics-Informed NNs (PINNs), and KANs.
- [12. Generative AI](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): VAEs, GANs, Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, ControlNet, multimodal AI, and synthetic data generation.
- [13. Large Language Models](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): Architecture of modern LLMs, tokenization, BPE, rotary embeddings (RoPE), KV cache, RAG, and fine-tuning.
- [14. Agentic AI](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): ReAct patterns, tool calling, memory management, multi-agent coordination, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and sandboxed execution.
- [15. Projects](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): Hands-on production machine learning and AI projects with verifiable code, datasets, and deployable Streamlit apps.
- [16. AI Engineering & MLOps](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): Model deployment with FastAPI/Docker, quantization (AWQ/GGUF), vLLM serving, monitoring, and data drift detection.
- [17. Career & Interview Preparation](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/curriculum): Technical questions, system design architecture, coding exercises, and behavioral frameworks for big-tech AI roles.

## Hands-On Project Handbooks (12)

- [Can You Survive the Titanic? Build a Machine Learning Predictor](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/projects/titanic-survival): A classic hands-on classification project rebuilt as a complete beginner-friendly handbook from raw CSV to a working prediction app. Uses Python, VS Code, JupyterLab, Pandas, NumPy.
- [What Is This House Really Worth? Build a House Price Predictor](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/projects/house-price): Build a real-estate-style price estimator and compare linear, regularized and ensemble regression models. Uses Python, VS Code, OpenML, Pandas, NumPy.
- [Can AI Catch a Stolen Credit Card Transaction?](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/projects/credit-card-fraud): Learn how real fraud problems differ from ordinary classification because fraudulent transactions are rare. Uses Python, VS Code, OpenML, Pandas, NumPy.
- [How Amazon Knows What Kind of Customer You Are](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/projects/customer-segmentation): Turn 541,909 real retail transactions into customer groups and learn why clustering can reveal patterns without labels. Uses Python, VS Code, UCI Online Retail, Pandas, NumPy.
- [Can We Predict Tomorrow's Sales? Build a Retail Forecasting System](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/projects/retail-forecasting): Build a forecasting workflow that learns trend and seasonality from historical store sales. Uses Python 3.12, VS Code, UCI Online Retail, Pandas, NumPy.
- [Build Your Own Netflix-Style Movie Recommendation System](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/projects/movie-recommender): Build a movie-similarity recommender from a reusable CC0 ratings dataset, then compare popularity, content, collaborative and hybrid ranking strategies. Uses Python, VS Code, Datanemics CC0 Data, Pandas, SciPy.
- [Can AI Detect a Real Disaster Tweet?](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/projects/disaster-tweets): Move from classic text features to modern Transformers while solving a recognizable NLP classification problem. Uses Python 3.12, VS Code, Kaggle Disaster Tweets, Pandas, Regex.
- [Teach AI to Read Handwritten Numbers - Build Your Own Digit Recognizer](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/projects/digit-recognizer): Train a neural network and CNN on handwritten digits, then turn the model into a small image prediction app. Uses Python 3.12, VS Code, Scikit-learn load_digits, NumPy, PyTorch.
- [Build Your Own ChatGPT-Style AI Content Creator](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/projects/ai-content-creator): Create, rewrite, summarize and review real business copy with a working Streamlit studio, optional LLM API generation and strict structured output checks. Uses Python 3.12, VS Code, Streamlit, Pydantic, JSON.
- [Chat With Your PDFs - Build Your Own RAG Assistant](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/projects/pdf-rag): Ask questions about real PDFs, retrieve supporting passages and verify page-level citations using a runnable, offline-first RAG system. Uses Python 3.12, VS Code, PyMuPDF, Scikit-learn, TF-IDF.
- [Build Your Own Perplexity-Style AI Research Assistant](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/projects/ai-research-assistant): Build an auditable research tool that plans a question, reads real source text, checks original quotes and publishes a clearly cited evidence brief. Uses Python 3.12, VS Code, Requests, Wikipedia API, Tool Calling.
- [Take an AI Model From Laptop to Production](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/projects/model-to-production): Turn a trained churn model into a real FastAPI service with strict validation, versioned artifacts, Docker, CI, drift checks and rollback. Uses Python, VS Code, Scikit-learn, Logistic Regression, FastAPI.

- [Generative AI Interview Handbook](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/blog/generative-ai-interview-prep-guide): A detailed Generative AI interview handbook covering generative modelling, GANs, VAEs, diffusion, multimodal systems, evaluation, safety, examples and practical code.
- [LLM & RAG Interview Handbook](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/blog/llm-rag-interview-prep-guide): A detailed LLM and RAG interview handbook covering Transformers, embeddings, vector search, chunking, retrieval, reranking, evaluation, safety, serving and system design.
- [Agentic AI Interview Handbook](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/blog/agentic-ai-interview-prep-guide): A detailed Agentic AI interview handbook covering tool calling, planning, memory, context, state graphs, agentic RAG, MCP, multi-agent systems, safety and evaluation.
- [Python for ML & AI Interviews](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/learn/python-ai-ml-interview): Solved Python interview problems for ML and AI roles with reasoning, code, dry runs, complexity, edge cases and practical data-processing patterns.
- [SQL for Data & AI Interviews](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/learn/sql-ai-data-interview): Solved SQL interview problems for data and AI roles with sample tables, step-by-step query logic, window functions, joins, analytics patterns and expected outputs.
- [ML/AI System Design Interview Handbook](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/learn/ml-ai-system-design-interview): Detailed ML and AI system-design cases covering requirements, architecture, data and feature pipelines, serving, scale, metrics, failure modes and trade-offs.
- [MLOps & Production AI Interview Handbook](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/blog/ai-engineering-mlops-interview-prep-guide): A detailed production AI handbook covering pipelines, CI/CD, registries, deployment, monitoring, drift, reliability, incident debugging and production trade-offs.
- [Behavioral & Project Interview Handbook](https://www.learnmlacademy.com/learn/behavioral-project-interview): A practical behavioral and project interview handbook with STAR frameworks, project deep dives, stakeholder scenarios, leadership questions and answer structures.
